title: Owambe, Owambe
summary: Tunde keeps the aisle clear, Ngozi serves the queue and KC saves an original recording. A blackout hides a bag's journey. When the lights return, all three are caught in the same story.

stages.title: One wedding. Three perspectives.
stages.text:
MC: The groom's mother is entering again. Please preserve your surprise.

Tunde: I brought fourteen guests. Somehow I am also carrying their introductions.
stages.summary: Tunde arrives at Lantern Court with wedding guests. Help the steward before returning to the bus.

stages.title: Match the invitation
stages.text:
Steward: Invitation colour?
Tunde: After three trips through traffic, all I see is amber.

The invitation has a BURGUNDY stripe on cream paper. Choose the matching guest sash.
stages.summary: The invitation's stripe is burgundy. Match the stripe, not the paper.

choices.label: Gold sash
choices.hint: The paper is cream, but the stripe is burgundy. Try the matching sash.

choices.label: Teal sash
choices.hint: Look at the burgundy stripe on the invitation. You can try again.

stages.title: A clear way through
stages.text:
A guest has put a chair across the aisle.
Steward: Your sash matches. Your bus is still not a guest.
Tunde: Good. It would ask for two plates.

Help everyone reach the hall safely.
stages.summary: Move the spare chair to the marked storage space so the aisle stays clear.

choices.label: Put it in the doorway
choices.hint: The doorway needs to stay clear too. The marked storage space is free.

stages.title: Keep the dance floor clear
stages.text:
The MC gives you three stage-prop tokens. Aim them at the collection tray beside the dancers. These are story props; your StreetCoins stay in your pocket.

Tunde: Even the tray is collecting transport money.
stages.summary: Place the three prop tokens in the collection tray, keeping the aisle and dancers clear.

choices.label: Aim the three tokens at the tray
Aim at the busy floor
choices.hint: Keep the dancers' feet clear. Use the collection tray beside them.

stages.title: Ngozi · Aunty Boss
stages.text:
Tunde: They are asking whether your rice has VIP service.
Ngozi: My rice has a queue.

Nneka: Chief's office put our unpaid folder inside that striped bag.
Ngozi: Receipts do not become paid because they attend a wedding.
Nneka: I will bring it where we can read it.
stages.summary: Ngozi manages the food queue. Nneka wants to recover unpaid catering records from the striped bag.

stages.title: First ticket · 12
stages.text:
Guest: I only need a small favour.
Ngozi: Then join the small end of the line.

The first guest holds ticket 12. Choose its tray.
stages.summary: Match ticket 12 to tray 12. Every guest keeps their place.

choices.label: Tray 18
choices.hint: This ticket says 12. Return that tray to the rack and try 12.

choices.label: Tray 21
choices.hint: Match the printed ticket number: 12. Nobody loses their lunch.

stages.title: Next ticket · 18
stages.text:
Ngozi: One guest served. The queue is still a queue, not an election.

The next ticket reads 18. Choose its tray.

choices.label: Tray 21
choices.hint: Read this guest's ticket: 18. You can correct the tray.

choices.label: Tray 12
choices.hint: Ticket 12 has been served. This guest has 18.

stages.title: Last ticket · 21
stages.text:
Guest: Can you round my wait down?
Ngozi: I have rounded my patience already.

The last ticket is 21. There is no timer penalty.

choices.label: Tray 18
choices.hint: The final ticket is 21. Put this one back and match 21.

stages.title: KC · Content is loading
stages.text:
Ngozi: Film the wedding, not the food I am counting.
KC: Aunty, the food is our strongest performer.

The MC and dancers are ready. Start by asking who wants to appear.
stages.summary: KC is filming. Ask the staged subjects for permission before recording them.

stages.title: The people in the frame
stages.text:
The MC and three dancers agree to be filmed. Guests at the side tables prefer to stay out.

KC: A very exclusive audience. With an actual guest list.

Choose your shot.
stages.summary: Include the MC and consenting dancers. Keep the side tables outside the shot.

choices.label: Frame the MC and consenting dancers
Pan across every guest
choices.hint: The side-table guests declined. The staged dancers agreed; keep others outside the frame.

stages.title: Keep the context
stages.text:
Your frame contains the MC and consenting dancers. The service EXIT sign is just outside it.

KC: A beautiful shot. Now let it remember where we were.

The sign will help place what happens next.
stages.summary: Include the service EXIT sign, while keeping the side tables out.

choices.label: Crop tighter around the MC
choices.hint: The exit sign supplies context. Include it without filming the side tables.

stages.title: Save the original
stages.text:
The recording is ready. Keep an original with its context; make a short edit afterwards.

KC: A clean original. My future apology has a backup.
stages.summary: Save the full original before making an edited headline version.

choices.label: Keep only a dramatic crop
choices.hint: Keep an original first. A short version can follow without losing context.

stages.title: The light goes out
stages.text:
MC: Welcome the groom's mother, for the first time since the last time.

The hall loses power.
MC: We have a generator.
A beat.
MC: The generator is also waiting for an invitation.

Nneka carries the bag toward the service exit. Bisi catches an ankle on a chair; Nneka stops to help. KC lowers the phone. Tunde clears the aisle.
stages.summary: During the blackout, Nneka carries the bag toward the exit, then helps Bisi. KC and Tunde help too. The original recording keeps the time and service-bell sound.

choices.label: Help, then wait for the lights

stages.title: Naija Street Life: Up NEPA!
stages.text:
The lights return. The crowd cheers: Up NEPA!

Chief's aide: Where is the bag?
Ngozi: Start with where the payment is.

A driver. A canteen queen. A content creator. One bag has connected their stories.
stages.summary: The bag is missing. Tunde's bus leaves with guests; Ngozi has records to recover; KC has footage with more context than he knows. Continue in Light Out.
